title: Technical Project Manager - Data Center
description:
Overview:

Sprout is a global IT hardware retirement provider for hyperscaler and enterprise clients. We leverage a nationwide footprint (and international partner network) combined with proprietary software to enable efficient end-to-end IT asset disposition with a focus on data-bearing devices from the client to the cloud. The company is headquartered in Charlotte, NC with additional operations near Sacramento, Dallas, and Boston. title: Energy Production Operator
description:
**Who We Are**

Cleveland Thermal has been keeping downtown Cleveland warm since 1894, and cool since 1993. As one of the few district energy systems of its kind in the U.S., we supply steam heat and chilled water to residential, commercial, government, and institutional customers across the city. It’s infrastructure most people never see but rely on every day.

We’re part of Corix, which designs, builds, and operates low-carbon district energy systems across North America. Together, we deliver reliable, efficient energy to communities, campuses, and new developments, helping them meet their climate goals without compromising on comfort.

We’re a dedicated team with a mission to cultivate enduring energy systems for communities to thrive. Our work is guided by four values: we put people first, we’re driven by curiosity, we’re committed to change, and we believe we’re built better together.

**About the Role**

Every day of the year, buildings across downtown Cleveland rely on Cleveland Thermal for the steam and chilled water that heat and cool their spaces. As an Energy Production Operator, you help keep that service running. You’ll operate and maintain the boilers, chillers, generators and supporting equipment at the heart of the plant, and you’ll make sure the system delivers clean, reliable energy 365 days a year.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes knowing how a system works from end to end. You’ll make rounds from the basement to the roof, monitor pressures and temperatures, manage water chemistry, and keep the plant safe and efficient. You’ll also work closely with a crew that depends on clear communication from shift to shift.
